main_text.head: CAPVT IX. De recto vsu libertatis Christianæ in rebus mediis.
IOANNES CALVINVS, AD FARELLVM, LIB. EPIST. COL. 11.
main_text.p: I.NOS ab omnibus liberi, servi simus pacis & concordiæ.

p.i: Hæc autem cognitio facit vt sua cuique in his rebus omnibus libertas constet, & QVANDAM nihilominus sibi quisque LIBERTATI NECESSITATEM vltro imponat, quatenus aut illud quod diximus τὸ πρέπον, aut charitatis ratio exiget.
Æquissimum est, CHRISTI jugum admittere, illudque agnoscere, legitimum libertatis nostræ vsum ab HOMINUM LICENTIA remotum esse.

page.notes: The Greek word τὸ πρέπον is printed in Greek letters; the printed form reads "τὸ πρέπον" as shown. The word "HOMINUM" is partly damaged in the scan (printed as "ΠΙΙΡΑΝΙ"-like letters); the reading is uncertain and marked here. Faint show-through from the reverse side appears throughout and is omitted.
